items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1961-06-15
items.q: Pierre Anderson played bass with Dick Salsis band.

ctx.x: Who did Pierre Anderson play with? I don't know about him.
Pierre Anderson played bass with Dick Salsis band. Uh huh. Dick Salsis. He's played with all the bands. Uh huh. He was a good, he was a good Suzaphone player.
He played with all the bands. Did he play in dance orchestras?
